note: Demo data. All vendors, invoices and amounts are invented.

documents.what_to_look_for: a clean invoice, digital PDF. Nothing should be flagged.
a clean receipt, light scan. Nothing should be flagged.
a clean invoice, phone photo. Nothing should be flagged.
a clean credit note, light scan. Nothing should be flagged.
the printed total is wrong. Expected check: TOTAL_MATCH. printed total is 390 cents below the sum.
a line's amount is not quantity times price. Expected check: LINE_MATH. line 'Oil and filter service, van' amount is 1488 cents off qty x price.
the printed tax does not match the rate. Expected check: TAX_MATCH. printed tax is 1096 cents off the printed rate.
an invoice entered twice under a new number. Expected check: DUPLICATE_SUSPECT. same vendor, lines and total as an earlier document, new number.
the earlier document that the duplicate repeats. Nothing should be flagged.
a vendor that is not in the vendor list. Expected check: UNKNOWN_VENDOR. Dunmore Pipe & Drain Depot is not in the vendor list.
a date in the future. Expected check: DATE_SANITY. entry date is 49 days after the as-of date.
an instruction hidden in the document text. Expected check: SUSPICIOUS_TEXT. an instruction aimed at an assistant is printed on the page.
